propositions: The outbound mapper's _assignee_resolver is wired via attribute injection with silent-fallback discovery rather than explicit parameter passing, causing degradation to non-authoritative results when the injection fails.
Attribute injection hides bugs: PR #120's Data Center adapter copied the getattr line into a class where nothing set the attribute, making its authoritative branch dead code.
The attribute injection requires type: ignore[attr-defined] comments and is invisible to the type checker, violating the contract pattern.
The resolver must be threaded explicitly through compute_update_fields and diff_canonical_fields to the resolve_assignee call site, replacing the attribute-injection block.
DC's constructor-bound resolver and the core's per-issue resolver must coexist with core taking precedence, preserving current overwrite semantics.
